authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 2,091 unique buyers but only 91 unique sellers in the first hour, alongside 4,126 buys. That pattern points to wallet fan-out or bot buying, not organic retail. GMGN flags 31 bundler wallets and a 52-wallet insider trade network (RugCheck). The image is duplicated 9 times, and there are about 10 same-name clones. There is no DexScreener profile and no socials of its own. Apart from the vise.fun project, which names a different contract, I found no organic mentions anywhere.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is inaccessible (HTTP 402), so I cannot rule out a caller or KOL pushing this CA.

structured_output.counterargument: The volume is large for its size ($850k in the first hour), and this copy trades above the official token ($181k vs $54k market cap), so traders may be treating it as the main VISE. If the 80% wallet is actually a program or vault account that RugCheck did not label, the supply overhang is not real, and momentum traders could push it back toward its $984k ATH, which would be a 5x. The vise.fun product (fee-sharing locks for pump.fun coins) is a plausible story that could bring more buyers to anything with this ticker.

structural_risks: A single unlabeled wallet (FhVo...) holds 80.05% of supply against only about $31k of pool liquidity. Selling it would drain the pool.

narrative.description: vise.fun is a real-looking protocol that lets holders lock pump.fun coins and pays out fees in SOL to people who stay locked. It has an official $VISE token and the X account @visedotfun.
narrative.why_spreading: The real project launched today and spawned many same-name clones. This contract appears to be one of those clones, trading on the name while the official token draws attention.

structured_output.thesis: This coin looks like a ticker hijack of the vise.fun project, whose own site names a different contract as the official $VISE. One wallet holds 80% of supply, the LP is unlocked, there are many bundlers, and the buyer pattern looks botted. The price is already 80% below its ATH and falling. Doubling from here is unlikely. A dump or drain within 6 hours is likely.
